about.title: About Me
about.intro: I am a civil engineer with a passion for architectural design and innovative solutions. With over 5 years of experience, I have successfully completed 171+ projects across residential, commercial, and industrial sectors.
about.expertise: My expertise spans from conceptual design to detailed BIM modeling and on-site project supervision. I specialize in creating designs that balance aesthetics, functionality, and sustainability.
about.education: I graduated from KUFA University with a degree in Civil Engineering, specializing in structural and water resource engineering.
about.interests: My interests include architecture, design, technology, programming, machine learning, and sustainable building practices.
